title_structure.description: Title length, punctuation, numbers, emoji, topic flags, openings and linguistic/readability patterns

title_ngrams.description: 64-dimensional SVD of word/bigram and character 3–5-gram hashing

sentiment_lexicon.description: VADER valence summaries, negation and hand-counted power words; not v5 emotional triggers

channel_context_priors.description: Channel median/support, relative title length, and cross-fitted title-performance priors/support

thumbnail_cheap_stats.description: Brightness, contrast, faces, colorfulness, edges, text/layout and derived cheap image traits

posting_time.description: Known/missing/coarse date indicators, hour and cyclical hour/weekday features

subscriber_size.description: Log subscribers, subscriber tier, tier×power-words and tier×title-length interactions

duration.description: Duration, log duration, duration relative to historical channel median

emotional_triggers_v5.description: Ten explicit v5 trigger scores and three summaries; inactive in the current head

external_public_priors_v5.description: Additional public-source prior scalars; inactive in the current head

thumbnail_embeddings.description: CLIP embeddings/PCA/prompt similarities used by v2, absent from v4/v5

novelty.description: V4 channel/topic familiarity candidates; not selected in the current head

prior_ridge_coefficients.description: Auxiliary TF-IDF prior coefficients, not final-head word effects; correlated, observational features

protocol.training_priors: saved GroupKFold out-of-fold values; fitting cohort only
assumptions: Fixed transformed-feature block removal, not causal removal of raw inputs
Correlated information remains in other blocks (title information also reaches performance priors)
Cross-block interactions assigned once and listed in feature dependencies
Transforms and priors stay frozen; only temporary remaining-column heads are fitted
One original head seed; retrain differences can include tie-breaking/random-order effects
Permutation SD measures shuffle variation, not a confidence interval over future data
Permutation breaks cross-block correlations and can create off-distribution combinations
Existing reused random per-channel development holdout, not future-time or causal validation
